column1: PART I : SEC. (I) - GAZETTE   EXTRAORDINARY   OF   THE   DEMOCRATIC   SOCIALIST   REPUBLIC   OF   SRI  LANKA -20.12.2019

column2: if the Contracting State in which he has his centre of vital interests cannot be determined, or if he has not a
permanent home available to him in either Contracting State, he shall be deemed to be a resident only of the
Contracting State in which he has an habitual abode;
if he has an habitual abode in both Contracting States or in neither of them, he shall be deemed to be a resident
only of the Contracting State of which he is a national;
if the status of the resident cannot be determined by reason of subparagraphs (a to c) in that sequence, the
competent authorities of the Contracting States shall settle the  question by mutual agreement.
